items.title: Airbnb (ABNB) Brings Over 1 Million Listings To A Major Card Travel Portal
items.summary: Airbnb (NasdaqGS:ABNB) and American Express have partnered to list over 1 million Airbnb properties on the Amex Travel platform. Eligible U.S. American Express Card Members can now earn Membership Rewards points and receive statement credits on Airbnb bookings made through Amex Travel. The arrangement connects Airbnb hosts with American Express's higher spending travel customers through a new distribution channel inside the issuer's booking portal.
